rationale: The program defines the InputReader class (req_01). It implements __iter__ which delegates to _read_file or _read_bucket to return an iterator over contents from files or S3 buckets (req_02). The constructor accepts a fail_on_missing parameter, and both _read_file and _read_bucket check this flag to either raise FileNotFoundError or return an empty iterator (req_03). The class includes a from_json classmethod to load from JSON (req_04) and a to_json method to convert back to JSON (req_05). All requirements are met.
